description: Shared MUWA-HMAC-V1 signing vectors. Consumed unchanged by PHP (tests/Unit/Service/Auth) and Go (agent/internal/api). Secrets are base64url without padding and are decoded to exactly 32 bytes before use as HMAC-SHA256 key; base strings use LF between fields and no trailing LF. bodyRepeat means the raw body is 'char' repeated 'count' times.
